t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Throughout the game the gnomes with longer hats are more likely to give more points. also different colours give different points higher than others such as pink gives more than blue and green more than orange.

vb_textbox.text: In most games the gnome with the smaller hat is most likely to pay you more points,so it is best to chose the gnome with the smaller hat when against a gnome with a longer hat. Colour of the gnome should also be noted when picking which gnome to choose as certain colours are more likely to pay more. Green gnome pays more than orange gnome, Red gnome pays more than brown gnome and Pink gnome pays more than blue gnome. now and then this does change up a little bit in the first 3 rounds but in the last round a reversal happens where colours or hat lengths of the opposite recommended above for the first three rounds pay more points so I would recommened on the last round to choose the opposite colour or length of what you would chose in the first three rounds.
